people.name: Ajoy Chawla
people.bio: Ajoy Chawla joined Tata Administrative Services in 1990 and Titan in 1991. He held various roles in the Watches Division, served as Chief Strategy Officer, and became CEO of Titan's Jewellery Division in 2019.

people.name: S Vijayakumar
people.bio: Dr. S. Vijayakumar is a 1993 batch IAS Officer who has held many key positions in various departments in the Government of Tamil Nadu. Presently, he is the Additional Chief Secretary to Government Industries, Investment Promotion and Commerce Department.
